title: Resource-Aware Grover Search for Minimum Vertex Cover
summary: The Minimum Vertex Cover (MVC) problem is a fundamental NP-hard combinatorial optimization problem with applications in network analysis and resource allocation. Grover's algorithm provides a quadratic reduction in query complexity for unstructured search, but existing Grover-based MVC formulations can incur substantial quantum resource overhead due to costly vertex-counting circuits and complex oracle constructions.
